audience: cleaning companies that run quotes, leads and bookings in MaidCentral

useCases.title: Price a clean for a new home
useCases.text: List the service types, frequencies and pricing questions. Then calculate the price of a weekly clean. Nothing is stored.

useCases.title: Check open dates for a job
useCases.text: Find the dates on which a job of a given length can be booked. Check that the postal code is in a service zone.

useCases.title: Review a lead and its quote
useCases.text: Open a lead to see the contact details, source and status. Then open its quote to read the price, hours and booked state per scope.

useCases.title: Create a lead from a phone call
useCases.text: Create a lead with the name, phone and postal code and pick a customer source. Turn off the lead email if you do not want to send it.

useCases.title: Quote a lead and book the first job
useCases.text: Create a quote for a lead, check open dates, then book the quote on the first job date. Booking emails are optional.

useCases.title: Log a note on a customer
useCases.text: Add a note, call or text record to a customer found by email or phone, for example the access instructions.
